tide_parameters.scope: dense initial named Parameters before ownership placement; shape/name/raw contiguous bytes

diagnostics.retention: one output window at a time; only hashes/scalars retained; separate from normal timing

execution.hooks: ordinary Python method/module hooks with locked counters; no thread-local dispatch mode

parameters.scope: all unique trainable backbone parameters including enabled ingress projections; no task head

textbook.assumption: all regions receive; all H act; D private scaled by k/n only for quad

audit.definition: unique Parameter scalars in effective owner/group/source slices; not gradients or physical loads
audit.deduplication: within sample/logical tick across regions; repeated ticks accumulate; no output causal attribution
audit.matrix_cost_definition: multiply-add pairs of executed NodeLinear rows including padding/adapters; not complete FLOPs

retention.kind: one-call semantic-atom bitsets and scalar stream aggregates; no scalar-parameter axis
retention.digest_definition: ordered newline JSON [sample,logical_time,unique_parameters] per actual call; total combined only

A.selection_rule: exact block count; nearest parameters over d=16*j >= 32, FFN=8*j in [2d,6d]; ties prefer FFN=4d
A.parameter_scope: main blocks and final RMSNorm; no embedding, task head or artificial unused weights

matching_boundary: zero initial state; actual prefill/decode/chunked schedule and sole final Timed drain; frozen constructors for every later timed sample
